name: Magic Fang, Communal
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2, ranger 2, summoner/unchained summoner 2

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Targets one living creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions like magic fang, except that it affects multiple creatures and the duration is split between the targets in 1-minute increments.
